title: Persian basics
about: The most common words of written and spoken Persian (wordfreq counts, grouped by dictionary word with tools/course/fa/rank.mjs), most common first, 50 to a unit. Names of people and places are left out, and verbs are listed by their infinitive. Each word has one short everyday sentence in standard written Iranian Persian, with its English translation; ⟦ ⟧ marks the part that translates the word. The romanisation in brackets follows Tehran speech: â as in 'father', a as in 'cat', e as in 'bed', o as in 'go', i as in 'see', u as in 'food'; kh and gh are said in the throat, and ' is a catch in the voice.
